info.name: Chariot FDX Accounts Donor Accounts API

params.name: giving_pool_id
params.description: The `id` of a [Giving Pool](/api/giving-pools). When set, filters Donor Accounts to those that have this Giving Pool associated with them.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter Donor Accounts to only those with the specified status.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter Donor Accounts by donor email. The match is case insensitive and exact.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Filter Donor Accounts by `external_id` — the DAF's internal identifier for the Donor Account.

params.name: page_limit
params.description: the number of results to return; defaults to 10, max is 100

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token to use to retrieve the next page of results. This is useful for paginating over many pages of results. If set, all other arguments are expected to be kept the same as previous calls and the value of this field should be from the next_page_token in the previous response.

items.docs:
Returns a list of Donor Accounts for the authenticated DAF.
This endpoint supports cursor-based pagination as well as filtering by fund, status, and email.

Create a new Donor Account.

This endpoint is intended for DAF providers who want to set up a Donor Account on behalf of a donor before that donor uses DAFpay for the first time.
See the [DAF-Initiated Setup guide](/guides/dafpay/donor-accounts/daf-initiated-setup) for the most common use of this endpoint.

items.docs:
Update mutable properties on a Donor Account such as `external_id`, the nested `donor` fields, and `metadata`.

The Donor Account's status is managed automatically through the Authorization Token verification flow and cannot be changed directly via this endpoint.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique id of the Donor Account.

items.docs:
Disable an approved Donor Account.

A disabled Donor Account remains `approved` but cannot submit new Grant Requests. Existing Grant Requests already in flight are unaffected — disabling does not retroactively cancel or reject prior activity. Use this when a DAF needs to temporarily prevent a donor from initiating new grants (e.g. account under review, donor offboarding) without rejecting the underlying identity verification.

items.docs:
Re-enable a previously disabled Donor Account. After this call, the Donor Account can submit new Grant Requests again.

This endpoint is idempotent — calling it on an account that is already enabled returns the Donor Account unchanged.

<Warning>
- The Donor Account must be in `approved` status. Calls on a `pending` or `rejected` account return status `409 Conflict`.
</Warning>
